name: sb7-brandscript
description: Donald Miller's SB7 messaging framework (Building a StoryBrand, 2017, and Building a StoryBrand 2.0, 2025) as a working sequence. Builds a BrandScript one decision per section (character, problem, guide, plan, call to action, failure, success, identity, controlling idea), checks it with a deterministic rule checker, prints a client worksheet and combined narrative, then runs the 2.0 messaging and marketing campaign: sound-bite testing, one-liner, eight-section landing page, lead generator, email or text drip, transformation stories and referral system. Adds workshop, approval, safeguard and launch-tracking tools from an independent implementation workbook, plus non-book scaffolds for ads, social posts and sales conversations. Includes a grunt-test audit, a read-only auditor agent and a first-edition internal team BrandScript.
